claim.why_it_matters: The choice indicators survive only as doubled corner glyphs, which read as two nested brackets rather than as 5.2.6.4 choice indicators, and - unlike DIVIDE Formats 1, 2 and 3 on page 644, each of which carries a 'Figure notes' paragraph stating 'The ON SIZE ERROR group is enclosed in CHOICE INDICATORS' and listing the underlined required words - Formats 4 and 5 carry no Figure notes at all. So for Formats 4 and 5 the file records neither the 5.2.6.4 semantics (ON SIZE ERROR, NOT ON SIZE ERROR, BOTH, or neither, in any order) nor which words are required.

verdict.reasoning: Independently confirmed on both sides; I tried to refute it and could not. PDF SIDE (E:/Temp/specrecon/v645/spec_p645.png, 300 dpi, cropped and magnified 2x for both the Format 4 and the Format 5 ON SIZE ERROR groups). What I actually see printed, in BOTH formats, is four distinct vertical strokes around the two-line group: on the left an opening square bracket (a vertical stroke with short horizontal serifs top and bottom) and, immediately to its right and separated by white space, a PLAIN full-height vertical bar with no serifs; mirrored on the right, a plain full-height vertical bar and then the closing square bracket. That is unambiguously the ISO metalanguage CHOICE INDICATOR of 5.2.6.4 - bars enclosed by brackets - and it is identical in shape to the group printed for Formats 1-3 on page 644. It is NOT a pair of nested brackets: the inner strokes carry no serifs and are taller than the bracket strokes. MARKDOWN SIDE (verified in the canonical source, specs/ISO_COBOL.md lines 26705-26706 and 26719-26720, not just in the extracted work unit, to rule out an extraction artifact). The claim quotes the file verbatim. Codepoint dump of the group delimiters: left-top U+2310 U+2310 (two REVERSED NOT SIGN), right-top U+00AC U+00AC (two NOT SIGN), left-bottom U+230A U+230A (two LEFT FLOOR), right-bottom U+2518 U+2518 (two BOX DRAWINGS LIGHT UP AND LEFT). There is no U+007C VERTICAL LINE anywhere in either group. The bar is therefore not reflowed, not moved to an adjacent line, and not encoded as some alternate glyph - it is simply gone, replaced by a duplicated corner. This is a doubled BRACKET corner, so the surviving reading is 'two nested brackets', i.e. optionality, not choice. This is not a formatting or transcription-style difference, because the file's OWN convention one page earlier writes the identical PDF construct correctly and explicitly: page 644 lines 24-25, 45-46 and 65-66 render it as '⎡| ON SIZE ERROR ... |⎤' / '⎣| NOT ON SIZE ERROR ... |⎦' with literal '|' bars. Page 645 is inconsistent with page 644 for the same figure element. FIGURE NOTES: also confirmed absent. The page-645 span in the source runs from line 26691 () to line 26737 (immediately before ), and contains no '> **Figure notes' paragraph at all - not after Format 4, not after Format 5, and not spilling onto page 646. Page 644 carries one after each of Formats 1, 2 and 3, each containing the warning 'The ON SIZE ERROR group is enclosed in CHOICE INDICATORS' plus the 5.2.6.4 gloss and the list of underlined required words. So the compensating prose that rescues Formats 1-3 does not exist for Formats 4-5. MEANING CHANGE: material. Under 5.2.6.4 bars-within-brackets means zero or more of the alternatives, each at most once, in any order - so one DIVIDE may legally carry ON SIZE ERROR, NOT ON SIZE ERROR, BOTH, or neither. The surviving nested-bracket rendering reads as 'optionally choose one of the stacked alternatives', which would wrongly forbid writing both phrases on the same DIVIDE ... REMAINDER statement. A compiler built from the markdown alone would under-accept legal COBOL. Two corrections to the claim's own wording, neither of which affects the verdict; see corrected_description.
verdict.corrected_description:
CONFIRMED, with two corrections to the claim's description.

(1) The claim overstates the underlining. In the printed page 645 the word ON is NOT underlined in either 'ON SIZE ERROR' or 'NOT ON SIZE ERROR' - the underlines sit under SIZE, ERROR and NOT only (ON is an optional word: '[ON] SIZE ERROR'). Underlined in Format 4: DIVIDE, INTO, GIVING, REMAINDER, SIZE, ERROR, NOT, END-DIVIDE. In Format 5: DIVIDE, BY, GIVING, REMAINDER, SIZE, ERROR, NOT, END-DIVIDE. Note this also means the page-644 Figure notes are themselves slightly wrong where they list ON among the underlined required words - a separate, lower-severity defect to raise against page 644.

(2) The lost glyph is described precisely as follows: the PDF prints, on each side of the two-line ON SIZE ERROR group, a square bracket plus a separate plain full-height vertical bar just inside it (5.2.6.4 choice indicators). The markdown has dropped the bar entirely and duplicated the bracket corner instead: U+2310 U+2310 / U+00AC U+00AC on the upper line and U+230A U+230A / U+2518 U+2518 on the lower line, with no U+007C present anywhere in the group. Both DIVIDE Format 4 (into-remainder) and Format 5 (by-remainder) are affected identically, at specs/ISO_COBOL.md lines 26705-26706 and 26719-26720.

Everything else in the claim holds: the markdown is quoted verbatim, the choice-indicator semantics of 5.2.6.4 are unrecoverable from the file for these two formats, and no Figure notes paragraph exists anywhere in the page-645 span to compensate - unlike Formats 1-3 on page 644, which both render the bars correctly as '⎡| ... |⎤' AND carry the explanatory note.

Additional in-scope defect found in the SAME two figures while verifying: the operand-selection BRACES are also degraded. The PDF prints true curly braces around the identifier-1/literal-1 and identifier-2/literal-2 stacks (braces = choose exactly one, mandatory). The markdown (lines 26699-26701 and 26713-26715) renders them as a bracket-like box outline built from U+2310/U+00AC/U+2514/U+2518 corners with '|' sides, which reads as a BRACKET (optional), not a brace - whereas page 644 renders the identical construct correctly with the proper brace glyphs U+23A7/U+23A8/U+23A9 and U+23AB/U+23AC/U+23AD. Recommend the fix for page 645 restore both the choice-indicator bars and the brace glyphs, and add Figure notes paragraphs for Formats 4 and 5 matching the page-644 pattern.

Recommended replacement for each of the two ON SIZE ERROR groups:
    ⎡|  ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-1      |⎤
    ⎣|  NOT ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-2  |⎦
